about: Planted bugs. Each one breaks one guard, and the named property must fail. Spec mutations edit spec/ImageRoute.tla and run TLC on MCImageRoute.cfg. Code mutations edit a copy of src/core/images/image_route.zig, rebuild the harness from it, and run both driver directions. Each find string must occur exactly once.

spec.breaks: Image support requires file-input as well as vision: the reported bug.
A reply's decision reads the support from before the reply.
A turn asks for capabilities again after it already asked.
The catalog-down notice repeats within a turn.
Tool images go inline while support is unknown.
A request delivered twice asks for capabilities twice.
spec.find: THEN pending' = <<r>> /\ out' = <<>> /\ UNCHANGED <<support, resolved, notified>>
spec.replace: THEN pending' = <<r>> /\ out' = <<[kind |-> "resolve"]>> /\ UNCHANGED <<support, resolved, notified>>

spec.breaks: A stale reply overwrites the turn's support.
spec.find: THEN out' = <<>> /\ UNCHANGED <<support, resolved, notified, pending>>
spec.replace: THEN out' = <<>> /\ support' = Derive(v) /\ UNCHANGED <<resolved, notified, pending>>

spec.breaks: User images without a route are sent anyway.
A new turn keeps the previous turn's notice flag.
spec.find: /\ notified' = FALSE   \* a new turn may tell the user again

spec.breaks: The vision tool is optional even while user images wait.
A reply leaves its request waiting.
The catalog-down notice comes after the answer.
spec.find: ELSE IF Notifies(s, r, n) THEN <<[kind |-> "notify"], Decide(s, r)>>
spec.replace: ELSE IF Notifies(s, r, n) THEN <<Decide(s, r), [kind |-> "notify"]>>

spec.breaks: A request delivered while a reply is owed is decided at once.
spec.find: THEN pending' = <<r>> /\ out' = <<>> /\ UNCHANGED <<support, resolved, notified>>
spec.replace: THEN pending' = <<r>> /\ out' = DecideOut(support, r, notified) /\ UNCHANGED <<support, resolved, notified>>

spec.breaks: Asking for capabilities does not mark the turn as having asked.
The core asks for capabilities for a request without images.
The catalog-down notice appears when the catalog is up.
Tool images vanish without a notice while support is unknown.
The vision tool is offered off the fallback route.
A native image model is routed through the vision tool.
spec.replace: LET route == CASE s = "native" -> (IF r.fallback THEN "fallback" ELSE "native")
